title: Regional Governance, Brackenridge Land, 1989 Events
summary:
*   **Regional Governance Discussed:** City leaders met with county officials to discuss "Joint Metro Government," setting plans for future collaborative meetings and the selection of a committee chairperson.
*   **Brackenridge Tract Review:** A report was presented during a worksession concerning the significant Brackenridge Tract.
*   **1989 Civic Event Planning:** The "150 Committee" outlined its upcoming schedule of events and observations planned for the year 1989.

Councilmember Humphrey and Councilmember Nofziger. At 3:28 P.M., Councilmember Barnstone
entered the meeting and Mayor Cooke officially called the special called meeting of the
Council to order. He noted the absence of Mayor Pro Tem Shipman and Councilmember Urdy and
indicated Councilmember Carl-Mitchell would arrive later. Councilmember Carl-Mitchell
arrived at 3:54 Ρ.Μ.
JOINT METRO GOVERNMENT
The Mayor, Councilmembers Humphrey, Nofziger and Barnstone held a discussion with
Commissioner Bruce Todd and County Judge Bill Aleshire and several members of the Joint
Metro Government Committee members.
They approved a selection process for the chairperson and also approved future meetings of
the Committee for January 12 and 17, 1989.
They approved a joint meeting of the Council, Commissioner's Court and Joint Metro
Government Committee for January 23, 1989 "150" COMMITTEE REPORT Mayor Frank Cooksey,
chairman, "150 Committee" presented the report of that Committee and outlined the dates
and events which will be observed in 1989.
BRACKENRIDGE TRACT
Tracy Watson, Director, Office of Land Development Services, presented a report during the
worksession on the Brackenridge Tract. ITEM POSTPONED Postponed to December 1, 1988 is the
selection of a legislative lobbyist.
